root_cause.runtime: Netlify production used Node 20.20.2 while the website build uses node:fs/promises.glob and current Netlify dependencies require Node >=22.12.
root_cause.content_contract: The generated daily blog initially missed parts of the technical SEO/evidence contract.
root_cause.component_projection: ensureTrustBar treated CSS text bg-uniform-trust as proof that an actual trustbar DOM element existed.
root_cause.delivery_closure: The material repair initially lacked Brain learning, activity-ledger and human documentation in the same candidate lineage.

prevention_rule: Pin Netlify builds to Node 22.12.0 or newer when active build code or dependencies require it.
Keep explicit Node heap capacity for localized route generation under a classified regression test.
Require full technical SEO and substantive evidence before a daily blog can merge.
Detect component presence from actual DOM elements, never a CSS selector substring alone.
Every material repair must include Brain learning, activity ledger and human documentation before Required test passes.
Never claim LIVE_BEWEZEN before protected merge, exact Netlify production identity and public HTTP 200 readback.
